title: Jasper van Brakel (CEO, RSF Regenerative Social Finance · Aspen Fellow) — 'An important book' on governance and ownership structures that serve human flourishing
summary: Jasper van Brakel — CEO of RSF Regenerative Social Finance, board member, Aspen Fellow, economist — endorses Incorruptible from inside the impact-finance world. Frames the book's core contribution as structural: businesses risk losing their mission as they grow, the causes are structural rather than incidental — and that means fixable through the business governance and ownership structures Eric presents. Tags Purpose Trust, Ownership Network, and Ownership Capital Lab as movement partners.
blockquote: As they grow, businesses risk losing their actual mission. The causes are structural rather than incidental. And that means they are fixable. In his recent book #Incorruptible, Eric Ries presents real solutions with business governance and ownership structures that can serve human flourishing rather than just profit maximization. An important book.
attribution_title: CEO, RSF (Regenerative Social Finance) · Board Member · Aspen Fellow · Economist
